name: Love Therapy
source:
Try to fall in love with one of the 12 girls. There are different locations to go and things to buy for her. To advance in the game the player got to have a succeed day with the girl or he will have to go through it again and again... To have a succeed date the player has to answer different questions that the girl will ask him and take her to places that she will like.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/L/SLPS-01370.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
尝试与12位女孩中的一位坠入爱河。你可以带她前往不同地点，也可以为她购买礼物。只有度过成功的一天，游戏才能继续推进，否则就得一遍遍重来……想要约会成功，你必须回答女孩提出的各种问题，并带她去她喜欢的地方。

[摘自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/L/SLPS-01370.html]PSX Data Center[/url]]
